content_code_consistency.content_reasoning: _validateSignature takes validUntil and validAfter from the last 12 bytes of the signature but recovers the signer from the EIP-191 hash of userOpHash only. The time window is therefore not signed, and a relayer can change it without breaking the signature.
patterns_found: validUntil and validAfter read from the trailing 12 bytes of the signature
signed hash covers only userOpHash, which does not include the time window
issues: A plain 65-byte signature is also accepted and gives validUntil = 0 and validAfter = 0, so a relayer can also strip the window completely.

scsvs_classification.vulnerability_type: signature validity window not covered by the signed hash
